result:
This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and ran no solve. I judged this from the model list alone and did not test component support.

- **MembraneContactor (`MC`):** no listed model does NH3 transfer across a membrane into an acid stream. The nearest candidates are `component_separator`, `conversion_reactor` and `tp_flash`. Each is a different unit, and none carries membrane area, flux or free-ammonia limits.
- **Evaporator (`EVAP`):** no listed model concentrates an ammonium solution into a salt stream. It would also need to give off a condensate heat stream (`EVAP.heat`) that feeds `HX2`. `tp_flash` and `ph_flash` only split vapor from liquid. They have no salt outlet and no heat port of that kind.
- **Substitutes:** the rules forbid swapping a different unit in, so I did not build one.
